question.text: What is the operating range (price band) for currency futures contracts with tenure up to 6 months?

explanation.text: The Logic: There are no daily price bands for currency futures. Operating ranges are set at +/-3% of the base price for contracts with tenure up to 6 months and +/-5% for tenure beyond 6 months. These ranges are relaxed in 1% increments based on market-wide trends. The Trap: +/-5% applies to contracts with tenure greater than 6 months, not up to 6 months. Note: Operating ranges serve to prevent erroneous order entry rather than functioning as hard daily circuit limits.
